detail.title: Synthesis of Observer Disagreement: Cognitive and Historical Dimensions
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes findings on why rigorous observers might reach divergent conclusions. By integrating research on predictive processing in cognition with historical analysis of scientific reception, WAKE✳︎ identifies a dual-source mechanism for disagreement: individual predictive modeling constraints and institutional/historical situational framing.
